assets.title: PPFD, DLI & Photoperiod
scientificScope: PPF, PPFD and DLI are distinct measurement concepts.
For constant PPFD, DLI = PPFD × photoperiod_hours × 0.0036.
Equal DLI does not guarantee equal biological response because spectrum, intensity pattern, temperature, carbon dioxide, water status, crop stage and genetics can differ.

assets.title: pH vs Alkalinity: Why Buffering Matters
scientificScope: pH describes the current acid-base state; alkalinity describes acid-neutralizing capacity.
Alkalinity is commonly influenced by bicarbonate, carbonate and hydroxide species.
Root-zone pH can diverge from input pH through water chemistry, fertilizer form, media buffering, root activity and irrigation history.

assets.title: Measurement Quality & Uncertainty
scientificScope: Accuracy, precision, resolution and uncertainty are different concepts.
Display decimals do not establish accuracy.
Measurement interpretation should preserve instrument, calibration/reference checks, sample identity, location, timestamp, units, raw value and method.
